questions.prompt: In Claude's guide, what does A/B testing mean as a measurement method?

options.text: Asking users to vote on every output as soon as the model has produced it
options.explanation: The guide lists user feedback as a separate method. A/B testing compares against a baseline model or an earlier version.

options.text: Comparing performance against a baseline model or earlier version
options.explanation: Right. This is the guide's description of A/B testing.

options.text: Running the same model twice and keeping whichever of the two runs scored higher
options.explanation: The guide compares against a baseline model or an earlier version, not two runs of one model.
